tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Search the DolfDarts encyclopedia (216 dart games) by text query with optional filters (category, mechanic, difficulty, player count, board type, max minutes). Returns matching games with their dolfdarts.com URLs.

tools.name: recommend_games
tools.description: Recommend a ranked shortlist of dart games for a given play context (player count, optional difficulty, time budget, and board type). Each recommendation includes a reason, the board it needs (boardType, boardLabel, boardUrl) and its dolfdarts.com URL. Most players have the standard board; when boar

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Get the complete record for one dart game by slug: objective, setup, rules, scoring, winning, variations, tips, equipment, and videos. Optionally narrow to specific sections. Includes the board the game is played on (boardType, boardLabel, boardUrl) and the dolfdarts.com URL.

tools.name: get_related_games
tools.description: List dart games related to a given game (similar mechanic, family, or commonly played together), with their dolfdarts.com URLs.

tools.name: get_dolf_rules
tools.description: Get the official World Dolf Federation (WDFF) rules and scoring for DOLF — the dart-golf hybrid game — as structured sections plus definitions. Includes the rules-of-dolf URL.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: List dart games filtered by category, mechanic, difficulty, and/or featured flag. Returns slug, name, category, difficulty, and dolfdarts.com URL for each.

tools.name: browse_taxonomy
tools.description: Get the encyclopedia's structure: all categories (6), mechanics (10) with descriptions, difficulties (4) and the 39 dartboard types (with labels and page URLs), each with live game counts, plus the total game count.

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Get the recommended steel-tip, double-out checkout for a score from 2 to 170: the route for 3, 2 and 1 darts in hand, alternatives on other doubles, and the best setup shot when there is no finish. Bogey numbers (159, 162, 163, 165, 166, 168, 169) and scores over 170 return checkout:false with the r

tools.name: get_setup
tools.description: Get the dartboard setup figures published on dolfdarts.com/setup: bullseye height, steel-tip and soft-tip throw distance, the diagonal check, wheelchair height, traditional regional boards, FAQ answers and sources, with the page URL.

tools.name: define_term
tools.description: Look up a darts glossary term (bust, oche, checkout, madhouse, Shanghai, ...) and get its sourced plain-text definition, origin when a source states one, source links and the dolfdarts.com glossary URL with the term's #anchor.
